name: King
source:
The owner of a big lion named Leo, King is the selfish ruler of Wonderland. Everyday, he eagerly searches for anybody who is or plans on standing up to him or betraying him. He loves to watch the despair and suffering of those he takes an interest in.

[Based on the [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/alice/#chara5]official website's character profile[/URL].]
